landing.title: Chronolignée
landing.subtitle: Explore your family through time.
landing.lead: A genealogy is not only a tree. It is lives that overlap, branches that migrate, sources that contradict each other — all of it in time.

time.title: Time as a dimension
time.body: Every life is an interval, not a date. The genealogical Gantt shows who was alive at the same time as whom.

evidence.title: Evidence before assertion
evidence.body: A birth date is not a field. It is a claim, backed by a source, and you can dispute it.

uncertainty.title: Uncertainty stays visible
uncertainty.body: "About 1877" never quietly becomes "1877". Soft edges stay soft.

duplicates.title: Duplicates
duplicates.lead: Two imports of one family leave the same person twice over. The search brings together records whose names resemble each other, then weighs the dates, the parents, the children and the places. It proposes: it never merges, and a father and his son of the same name remain two people.
duplicates.mergeIsForStewards: Merging retires a record from the tree: only stewards can do it. You can compare records and dismiss the matches that are wrong.
duplicates.searchInterrupted: The last search stopped short. Run it again.
duplicates.none: No match is waiting. The search compares names that are close, then the dates, the parents, the children and the places; it proposes nothing that a date or a family link rules out.
duplicates.comparisonLead: {percent}% match{signals}. The score only says what resembles what; the decision is yours.
duplicates.mergeKeepsEverything: Merging keeps everything: both dates of birth stay, one and the other, on the record that is kept. The merged record is not erased, it is withdrawn from the tree, and the history keeps a trace of the operation.
duplicates.mergeOnlyForStewards: Merging retires a record from the tree: only stewards can do it.
duplicates.confirmMerge: The record of <name>{of}</name> will be withdrawn from the tree. Its names, its events, its links and its sources move onto <name>{kept}</name>, which keeps its address.

privacyHints.INHERIT: Hidden from visitors while they may still be alive, if the tree asks for it.
privacyHints.REDACTED: Hidden from anyone outside the tree: name, dates and places, even after their death.
privacyHints.RESTRICTED: Hidden from the tree’s editors, contributors and readers as well.
privacyHints.VISIBLE: Visible to anyone who can read the tree. For those who have consented to it.

history.title: History
history.lead: Every change to the tree, by whom, and what it changed. Nothing is erased from here: a corrected value stays readable, for the day the correction turns out to be the mistake.
